title: A Well for the Visitor
author: Ada Lockridge
blurb: Rafael Eriksen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
